title: Move the rounding rule into its own module
requirement: Behaviour-preserving refactor: move the CENT constant and the round_money function out of invoicekit/money.py into a new module invoicekit/rounding.py, which becomes their single definition (money.py must no longer define the rounding itself). Existing import paths must keep working and refer to the same objects: invoicekit.money.CENT, invoicekit.money.round_money and invoicekit.round_money. No observable behaviour may change.
